name: Montana

law.summary: No Montana statute, rule or permit clause found that requires public notice of a sewage overflow. Permittees report to DEQ orally within 24 hours and in writing within five days on DEQ's SSO form; the reports stay with DEQ.

citations.title: Twenty-four Hour Notice of Noncompliance Reporting
citations.quote: The permittee shall report any serious incident of noncompliance affecting the environment as soon as possible, but no later than twenty-four (24) hours from the time the permittee first became aware of the circumstances.
citations.channel: Water Protection Bureau or Disaster and Emergency Services (regulator only)
citations.threshold: noncompliance which may seriously endanger health or the environment; unanticipated bypass

citations.title: Five-day written report (named on DEQ's SSO form)
citations.quote: The submittal of this form will fulfill the five day written report requirement for your permit and Administrative Rules of Montana (ARM) 17.30.1342(12)(f)(i)

erule.notes: No Montana rows in SOBE; DEQ's own paper/PDF SSO form.

statewide_feed.notes: No public list of reported overflows or spills that include sewage found.

sso.notes: SSO reports go to the state agency only.

habs.program: DPHHS/DEQ HAB reports and advisories map (HAB.mt.gov)
habs.notes: Service behind the map not traced.

shared_waters: Kootenai River and Lake Koocanusa (ID, British Columbia)

barriers.what: No public notice duty; SSO reports go to DEQ on a form and are not published
SSO event forms obtainable only by records request (DEQ records coordinator)
Some permits (Missoula MT0022594) are scanned images

readiness.rationale: No overflow feed, no SOBE rows, no CSOs, no public notice duty. Outfalls, the rain caution, HAB map link and the plain statement only.

owner_questions: Records request to Montana DEQ for SSO event forms (they carry coordinates, volume and receiving water)?
surprise: Montana's SSO form asks for everything a public feed would need (lat/long, receiving water, start and end), yet none of it is published.
